gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Bold and distinctive is hard to dodge here, but Gugi does it with tall lowercase. Noto Sans Mahajani is a plain sans with a funnel-wide e, and what the pair does best is hold two different kinds of height side by side.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam fills the middle of each line with an s that opens generously at its bends. And Gugi, the display heading, glides along like wire, so one handles the headline's pull while the other handles the steady reading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Gugi's most distinctive trait is its lack of any thick or thin shift, every stroke carrying the same push. Noto Sans Mandaic, a sans-serif body with curvy, unclamped lowercase, is the one built for reading, while the heading simply makes a statement.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Rope-fine strokes, tall and bold. Gugi makes the shapes, and if the heading went small, those delicate lines would lose their pull, while Noto Sans Marchen, a sans-serif body with proud small letters and clear daylight in its curves, holds up fine.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals: Ribbon-cut strokes, tall and loud. Gugi grabs attention with its constant-width lines, while Noto Sans Mayan Numerals, a sans with tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c, does the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Distinctive is the right word for Gugi, whose marker-nib line ignores direction entirely. But Noto Sans Medefaidrin, a sans-serif body with high-rising lowercase, is where the reading actually gets done.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and large lowercase eyes, giving a sans-serif body real character. And Gugi, with strokes free of thin or thick, is the strongest quality here: two voices that both shout their shapes.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic reads openly, with c shapes you can see straight through and lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Shrink Gugi though, and its marker-like line loses punch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve, and its lowercase sits close to capital height. And across a longer passage it would read cleanly, while Gugi draws its strokes at one weight above it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-mono: Sturdy, large-looking words come from Noto Sans Mono, whose generously spaced letters never bump together. Noto Sans Mono and Gugi share tall lowercase, and that, plus Gugi's crossbars fat as its stems, is the pair's strongest quality.
